orientation_rule: no orientation rule: undecided pairs are abstentions (or 'yes' in the forced view)

metric_defs.coverage: share of (target, variable) pairs given a committed claim
metric_defs.precision_committed: share of committed claims that match the true graph
metric_defs.forced_precision: accuracy when undecided reachability counts as yes
metric_defs.agreement_with_data_committed: share of committed claims matching a Welch test on held-out interventional rows (alpha 0.01)
metric_defs.ancestor_aid: Henckel et al. ancestor adjustment identification distance, normalised (gadjid)
